description:
Get how to apply for financial assistance at one facility: application link, deadline, documents to gather, financial counseling phone, and the plain-language summary link.
Use it after check_eligibility shows likely_free, likely_discount, or unknown, or whenever the patient asks how to apply.
Pass the facility id from find_facilities.
If a field is null we do not have it. Tell the patient to call the billing or financial counseling office and ask. Do not invent a deadline or a document list.

facility_id.description: Hospital CCN, facility slug, or health center org id.

name: get_application_steps
title: How to apply for financial assistance
